description: Export the throttleRAF utility function from the excalidraw package to make it available for external use. Ensure the function is properly testable by implementing appropriate unit tests that verify its throttling behavior using requestAnimationFrame.
functional_requirements: Export throttleRAF function from the main excalidraw package entry point
Maintain existing throttleRAF functionality while making it accessible to external consumers
Create comprehensive unit tests that verify the throttling behavior works correctly with requestAnimationFrame
Ensure tests cover edge cases and different usage scenarios for the throttleRAF function
Update any existing test mocks or setup files as needed to support testing the exported function
Maintain backward compatibility - existing internal usage of throttleRAF should continue working unchanged
